extension.description: [COLOR limegreen]Open[/COLOR]Wizard offers many maintenance features, selective add-on data saving, and automated build installs.
extension.news: 2.5.9 - Removed the Purge All Databases entry added in 2.5.8; Purge Databases stays where 2.5.8 moved it (right after Clear Crash Logs, before the Clear Video Cache section) 2.5.8 - Maintenance > Cleaning Tools: Purge Databases now sits right after Clear Crash Logs (before the Clear Video Cache section; this reverses the 2.5.3 placement), followed by a new Purge All Databases entry that empties every database file after one confirmation (a single summary notification instead of one per file) 2.5.7 - Fixed a startup crash (TypeError: '>' not supported between 'str' and 'int') in the installed-build check when the saved build error count was empty 2.5.6 - Clear Cache: removed Dradis and FenLight (their Include toggles and cache lists) 2.5.5 - Clear Cache and Total Clean Up empty the selected video cache databases automatically (the "Empty N cache database(s)?" question is gone; what is emptied is written to the log) 2.5.4 - Total Clean Up now also clears old thumbnails, crash logs and the archive cache (one confirmation, no extra prompts); its size counts the archive cache 2.5.3 - Maintenance > Cleaning Tools: the Clear Video Cache section (Include toggles) now sits right before Purge Databases 2.5.2 - Fixed the missing label of the "Include Prism Cache DB" toggle (strings.po entry was not separated by a blank line) 2.5.1 - Clear Cache: removed the Include toggles and cache lists for discontinued add-ons (Exodus Redux, Gaia, NuMb3r5, Scrubs v2, THE CREW, Venom, Yoda); Save Data is unchanged 2.5.0 - Clear Cache: Umbrella's source-results database is now found (providers.db); Prism and Redlight cache databases added, each with its own Include toggle - Clear Cache also removes leftover add-on install folders (addons/temp) that are more than a day old 2.4.0 - Settings converted to the current Kodi settings format (labels now come from strings.po); every setting keeps its id, type and default, so saved values carry over 2.3.3 - Internal: the folder-cache list used for the cache size and for Clear Cache is now defined once (no behaviour change) 2.3.2 - Faster menus: the settings refresh done on every menu action now builds one add-on object instead of one per setting 2.3.1 - Clear Cache: TMDb Helper's cache databases are now found (database_v6 folder) and limited to the five its own "Delete cache" offers (TMDb, Trakt, FanartTV, OMDb, Item Details); its sync and history databases are never touched - The database confirm dialog now shows a one-line summary per add-on instead of a file list that did not fit 2.3.0 - Clear Cache: emptying the cache databases now actually works (the old DELETE + VACUUM sequence failed and rolled back on Python 3); each database is emptied all-or-nothing and a locked one is skipped - New confirm dialog before databases are emptied (manual Clear Cache only) - Only regenerable caches are cleared: Seren providers.db and search.db and Otaku search.db are no longer included, torrentScrape.db is dropped and Seren providerPerf.db is added - Add-on settings are re-read on every menu action, so toggles take effect immediately (no Kodi restart needed with reuselanguageinvoker) - "Removed N Files" counts only databases that were really emptied - Cache size no longer counts the same folders twice when the profile path differs from the add-on data path 2.2.3 - Cache clearing: the per-addon database lists, the include toggles and the Cleaning Tools rows now come from one registry (cache_registry.py); behaviour is unchanged 2.2.2 - Remove bundled Python 2 zipfile module and its import fallbacks - Cache clearing: only file-system errors (OSError) are caught now, failures are logged at debug level; other exceptions are no longer silently swallowed - Drop stale __pycache__ folders from the package - Trim changelog (versions before 2.0.0 removed) 2.2.1 - Fix TypeError crash on startup when build server is unreachable (bool vs string comparison in main_menu.py and build_menu.py) 2.2.0 - Add cache clearing support for Umbrella, Dradis, POV, FenLight, Otaku, Otaku Testing, TMDb Helper, Diamond Info, Extended Info - Update Seren cache DB list (torrentCache, debridCache, providers, search) - Add Diamond Info image/TheMovieDB cache folder clearing - Individual toggle controls for each new addon in Maintenance menu 2.1.0 - Kodi 22 (Piers) compatibility - Remove deprecated xbmc.makeLegalFilename (use xbmcvfs) - Remove deprecated ListItem.setInfo (use InfoTagVideo) - Remove deprecated ListItem iconImage/thumbnailImage params - Remove script.module.six dependency (Python 3 only) - Update kodi_version() to recognize Nexus, Omega and Piers - Update mirror URL to omega repository 2.0.7 - Fix Error when using default log settings 2.0.6 - Fix regex for formatting tags - Fix theme selection after build install - Fix downloading into invalid path 2.0.5 - Add Enable All Add-ons after Build Install 2.0.4 - Fix leftover broken dialogs 2.0.3 - Don't show previous version builds in Matrix 2.0.2 - Replace remaining occurences of LOGNOTICE 2.0.1 - Add attribution to @slamious 2.0.0 - Initial Matrix support
